build_trident_faster_rcnn: build a TridentFasterRCNN model with TridentResNet backbone and 3 parallel branches
configure_trident_resnet: configure TridentResNet backbone with trident_dilations (1,2,3) and num_branch=3
setup_trident_roi_head: setup TridentRoIHead with 3 branches and select test_branch_idx=1 for inference
train_coco_detection: train TridentNet on COCO detection dataset using 1x schedule with caffe pretrained weights
run_trident_inference: run TridentFasterRCNN inference using the middle branch (test_branch_idx=1) for object detection
